title: Tranception Research Cheatsheet: Coding Variants, Chronic Threat, and Neurodevelopment
intended_audience: protein language model and variant-effect prediction researchers
one_sentence_message: Use Tranception as one bounded protein-evidence layer for naturally occurring coding variants; do not use it to claim that war, breastfeeding stress, family conflict, cortisol, dopamine, serotonin, or sugar causes ADHD.

research_hint.question: Do Tranception scores add reproducible protein-level information when prioritizing naturally occurring missense and in-frame indel variants in stress-regulation and neurodevelopment-related proteins?
research_hint.valuable_extension: Report mirror disagreement, retrieval gain, MSA provenance, retrieval-weight sensitivity, scoring-window sensitivity, and model-scale spread instead of exporting only one aggregate score.
research_hint.critical_limit: Protein-sequence fitness is not ADHD liability, trauma, neurotransmitter concentration, parenting quality, child safety, or clinical prognosis.

hawkar_fork.audit_conclusion: No divergence was detected at the audited head, README, or primary scoring script. The fork is currently a clean research mirror.
hawkar_fork.recommended_role: Host reproducible manifests, uncertainty exports, ablation utilities, and research documentation without obscuring upstream provenance.

indels.retrieval_requirement: The supplied workflow requires Clustal Omega and uses batch size 1.

repository_metrics: performance by mutation depth where supported

three_layer_separation.sequence_layer: Can the amino-acid variant be evaluated against learned autoregressive and homolog constraints?
three_layer_separation.regulation_layer: Does chronic threat alter expression, methylation, endocrine signaling, sleep, caregiving, or neural development? Tranception does not answer this.
three_layer_separation.phenotype_layer: Does a variant contribute to ADHD, trauma-related symptoms, or resilience? This requires human genetics, exposure measurement, functional evidence, and clinical interpretation.
three_layer_separation.rule: Do not jump from a protein score to a child's diagnosis or destiny.

proposed_study.working_title: Bidirectional Retrieval-Aware Variant Scoring in Stress-Regulation and Neurodevelopmental Proteins
proposed_study.primary_hypothesis: Tranception may add protein-level evidence after controlling for conservation, MSA properties, protein family, variant class, and baseline predictors.
proposed_study.secondary_hypothesis: Mirror disagreement, retrieval dependence, and alpha sensitivity may identify variants that require experimental validation rather than a confident scalar prediction.

study_tracks.rule: Start from reproducible large human genetic studies, then retain only missense and in-frame indel variants with unambiguous protein mapping.
study_tracks.example: SORCS3 merits inspection because a large ADHD study reported convergent common and rare-variant evidence, but it is not a single-gene explanation.

study_tracks.boundary: These are mechanistic pathway candidates, not a validated ADHD panel. Exposure effects may be regulatory or epigenetic and therefore invisible to a protein-sequence model.
Use these for method evaluation only; do not present a serotonin-only or dopamine-only theory.

match_on: membrane or soluble class where possible

include: naturally occurring in-frame insertions and deletions
public DMS variants with a relevant measured protein function
benign and damaging controls selected without using the Tranception score
not_represented_by_primary_test: war, household conflict, breastfeeding stress, sleep loss, or media exposure

uncertainty_exports.name: mirror_delta
uncertainty_exports.definition: Absolute forward-versus-reverse score difference before averaging.
uncertainty_exports.status: Requires instrumentation beyond the default aggregate output.

uncertainty_exports.name: retrieval_gain
uncertainty_exports.definition: Hybrid score minus autoregressive-only score under matched settings.

uncertainty_exports.name: alpha_sensitivity
uncertainty_exports.definition: Score range or variance across the retrieval-weight grid.

uncertainty_exports.name: msa_provenance
uncertainty_exports.definition: Depth, coverage, gap filtering, focus-column coverage, target inclusion, and weight-file identity.

uncertainty_exports.name: window_sensitivity
uncertainty_exports.definition: Score variation across valid windows for targets exceeding context length.

uncertainty_exports.name: model_scale_spread
uncertainty_exports.definition: Variation across small, medium, and large checkpoints.

primary: Spearman correlation with continuous functional assays
AUC and MCC only when a defensible binary label exists
bootstrap uncertainty across proteins and assays
comparators: at least one modern sequence-only protein language model
a held-out model testing incremental value beyond MSA depth, conservation, protein length, and variant class
failure_conditions: performance vanishes after matching conservation or MSA depth
results depend on one alpha or checkpoint
mirror disagreement is high but hidden
scores are presented as diagnosis or destiny

safe_command_template.boundary: Use public or ethically approved natural and assay variants. This is not an instruction to engineer embryos, expose children, alter neurotransmitter systems, or create harmful proteins.

recommended_fork_additions.status: proposal only; this registry change does not modify Hawkar-usls/tranception
reproducibility: record upstream commit and checkpoint identity
record tokenizer hash, MSA provenance, command line, seed, and environment
use synthetic schemas or de-identified approved data only

message_to_researchers.note: A useful extension is to score naturally occurring coding variants selected from robust ADHD genetics and stress-regulation pathways while treating chronic threat as an environmental and regulatory exposure, not as a source of protein mutations. The deliverable should be an uncertainty-aware protein evidence layer, not a disease score.
message_to_researchers.requested_output: A transparent benchmark and methods note, not a diagnostic product.

ethics_and_child_safety.anchor: The adult must arrive before chronic danger forces the child to become their own armor.
hard_boundaries: No embryo, child, parent, school, insurance, custody, or reproductive ranking from a Tranception score.
No claim that war or family conflict causes the scored coding mutations.
No claim that breast-milk cortisol suppresses dopamine and causes ADHD.
No claim that chronic conflict creates serotonin tolerance.
No intentional human neurotransmitter or stress-axis gain-of-function design for enhancement or self-experimentation.
No identifiable child, family, pregnancy, or clinical records in a public repository.
No use of genetics to excuse violence, neglect, propaganda, or failure to protect.
ethics_and_child_safety.seal: Score the protein, not the worth or destiny of the child.

supports: rare coding burden in a prioritized set
environmental effects may involve HPA-axis epigenetic regulation
NR3C1 and FKBP5 are studied in this context
